title: Complaints About Veterinarians and Proposal to Form Professional Body for Self-regulation
what_it_is: Complaints About Veterinarians and Proposal to Form Professional Body for Self-regulation

sections.label: Veterinary complaints and outcomes
sections.summary: AVS received 65 veterinary complaints over three years, issuing 10 warnings and one compound fine, with investigations taking up to 12 months or longer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Over the last three years, AVS received a total of 65 veterinary complaints, comprising 15 cases in 2019, 25 cases in 2020 and 25 cases in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Of these cases, 10 veterinarians were issued warnings and one was issued a compound fine.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: None was suspended or had his/her licence revoked.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Investigations can take up to 12 months or longer, as AVS needs time to gather the evidence, including detailed medical records and accounts from all parties, to make a thorough assessment.

sections.label: AVS committee and professional standards
sections.summary: An AVS-appointed committee evaluates complaints, and AVS is working with the Singapore Veterinary Association to raise professional standards, including a possible professional entity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The Committee appointed by AVS comprises AVS veterinarians, practising veterinarians and non-affiliated legal professionals to ensure that the complaints are evaluated robustly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: AVS is working with the Singapore Veterinary Association to raise professional standards of the veterinary sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We are exploring a number of ideas to advance the standards and practices of the sector, including the possible establishment of a professional entity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We are consulting veterinarians, vet para-professionals and vet service users to seek their views and will share more details when ready.

sections.label: Ongoing work and details
sections.summary: This is ongoing and more details will be shared when ready.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Indeed, this is something that is ongoing and we hope to share more details when ready.
